/test‑pipeline/
│
├─ docker/                     # Docker image definition (mirrors CI)
│   └─ Dockerfile
│
├─ repos/                      # Will be filled automatically (git clones)
│
├─ scripts/
│   ├─ bootstrap.sh            # Pulls PRs, creates test branches, runs tests
│   ├─ run_mcc.sh              # Wrapper that invokes the existing MCC harness
│   ├─ run_aafl.sh             # Wrapper for the AAFL health‑check framework
│   └─ run_wccl.sh             # Wrapper for Work‑Checker (WCCL/WCTL)
│
├─ ci/
│   ├─ .github/
│   │   └─ workflows/
│   │       └─ queued‑pr‑validation.yml   # CI job (optional: CI‑only mode)
│   └─ test‑config.yml                     # Global test configuration
│
└─ docs/
    └─ verification‑log.md                # Human‑readable log of each run
